title: Geometric Flow enhanced Graph Coarsening
abstract: arXiv:2609.14962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, researchers have proposed a graph pooling operation, akin to the pooling process in conventional convolutional neural networks (CNN), aimed at reducing the computation cost of Graph convolutional neural networks (GCNNs). While most GCNN-based methods treat graph pooling as a node clustering problem and propose learning a cluster assignment matrix, existing clustering-based pooling methods tend to focus solely on the rough topology information of graphs, neglecting the exploitation of higher-order mutual connections among neighbors. In terms of message passing on graph, the ease of information passing on edges reflects the closeness between neighboring nodes, which significantly relies on the interconnectivity among neighbors. In this study, we address this gap by considering such local connection information and introducing a novel graph pooling method named RicciPool. We introduce discrete graph curvature, particularly Ollivie

translated_abstract: 近年来，研究者提出了一种图池化操作，类似于传统卷积神经网络（CNN）中的池化过程，旨在降低图卷积神经网络（GCNNs）的计算成本。大多数基于GCNN的方法将图池化视为节点聚类问题，并提议学习一个聚类分配矩阵；然而，现有的基于聚类的池化方法往往只关注图的粗略拓扑信息，忽视了对邻居间高阶相互连接关系的挖掘。在图上的消息传递方面，信息在边上传递的难易程度反映了相邻节点之间的紧密程度，而这在很大程度上依赖于邻居间的互连性。在本研究中，我们通过考虑这种局部连接信息来弥补这一空白，提出了一种名为RicciPool的新型图池化方法。我们引入了离散图曲率，特别是Ollivier-Ricci曲率……
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RicciPool的新型图池化方法，通过引入离散图曲率（Ollivier-Ricci曲率）等几何流信息来捕捉邻居间的高阶局部连接关系，克服了传统基于聚类的池化方法仅关注粗略拓扑信息的局限，从而提升图粗化效果并降低图卷积神经网络的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RicciPool, a novel graph pooling method that leverages discrete graph curvature (Ollivier-Ricci curvature) to capture higher-order local connection information among neighbors, overcoming the limitation of clustering-based pooling methods that only exploit rough topology, thereby enhancing graph coarsening and reducing the computation cost of GCNNs.
